name: UT-Austin TRIGA hot channel, 24.34 kW, at the axial peak (compare with SAR Figure 4.30)
label: sourced
citation: University of Texas TRIGA II SAR, Chapter 4 (8/2023): geometry Table 4.1 (fuel diameter 1.435 in = 3.6322 cm, cladding thickness 0.020 in, outer diameter 1.475 in, fuel length 38.10 cm), fuel conductivity 0.18 W/cm/K (Table 4.1), 304 stainless steel cladding k 16.6 W/m/K at 400 K (K-State SAR Table 4.6, same alloy), hot channel power 24.34 kW (section 4.6) with element axial peaking 1.017 (Table 4.17) over 0.381 m: q' = 24.34 kW / 0.381 m x 1.017 = 64.97 kW/m. READ FROM FIGURE 4.30 (TRACE output, digitized, docs/sources/ut-triga-fig-4.30.json): the cladding outer surface temperature 132.9 C is the boundary here, and the effective gap conductance 4096 W/m2/K is the fuel-surface heat flux over the 139.0 K gap drop in that figure (295.1 C to 156.1 C). Both are therefore outputs of the SAR's TRACE model used as inputs; the comparison below tests only the conduction in the fuel and cladding.
description: A comparison case, not an oracle. The SAR gives no film coefficient for the UT hot channel (it used TRACE), so the outer wall temperature and the gap conductance are taken from TRACE's own radial profile (Figure 4.30) and FEED is asked to reproduce the rest. FEED treats the fuel as a solid cylinder with k = 18 W/m/K and gets a centre of 576 C against the figure's 562.5 C (+14 K, 3% of the rise above the wall); the cladding inner surface is 6 K below the figure. The real element has a 6.35 mm zirconium fill rod in the centre; the annular case (examples/ut-triga-hot-channel-annular.json) gives 545 C (18 K below the figure), so the figure lies between the two models. The profile's shape favours the annulus, and the annular fit implies an effective conductivity of about 17 W/m/K against the 18 used here. The digitized profile, fitted as a solid cylinder with k = 18, implies q' = 64.8 kW/m, which matches the 65.0 kW/m from the SAR's tables to 0.3%. Not normal operation at licensed power (24.34 kW is the limiting hot channel). Thermal only.
